modules.qualification: See verification.json; native interaction handoff needs full desktop qualification
Local simulated providers do not qualify external services
External services require separate live qualification

limitations: Program execution is not an OS sandbox
Graph mutations use the bundled Python librarian
Native permissions and interactive sessions are required
Windows/macOS/Wayland are not qualified by Linux tests

webDeployment.authentication: Password login, hashed session cookies and CSRF; administrator-created accounts
webDeployment.coreIsolation: Per-user Bubblewrap namespaces, private data/home/workspace and lifetime ownership flock
webDeployment.credentialStorage: AES-256-GCM fields bound to the user; external master key; one-time independent credential import
webDeployment.providerTools: Native Codex tool calls and validated textual Gemrouter bridge; core approvals apply to both
limitations: Web deployment does not qualify desktop releases or Windows/macOS
Host network is shared; configured egress proxy is not a kernel-wide firewall
SQLite metadata, core history, browser profiles and workspace files are not wholly encrypted
Resource ceilings are aggregate, not per-user cost or CPU quotas
MCP accepts public HTTPS endpoints only; local commands and host execution tools are denied
Gemrouter quota remains unavailable without real quota data; Antigravity requires a supported credential
External models and MCP services require separate live qualification
OCR and reusable-knowledge pattern checks are fallible; human verification/review remains necessary
webDeployment.appearance: Dark default on public and authenticated screens; persistent light/dark choice
webDeployment.browserObservation: Independent watched tab and operative target; follow agent or inspect another owned tab without taking control; idle hidden-tab screenshots use CDPScreenshotNewSurface and fromSurface:true without physical activation
webDeployment.assistantHarness: Current untrusted tab metadata, explicit target IDs, per-run tool scope, assisted forms and verified continuation after interruption
webDeployment.assistantMarkdown: GFM semantic layout for live and saved responses; final sanitizer; local pinned libraries
webDeployment.chatManagement: Per-user persistent names and pins; confirmed deletion of idle chat history, browser profiles, recordings and artifacts; workspace files retained
webDeployment.localization: EN default; persistent direct EN/IT toggle on public/authenticated screens; original user/model/provider content preserved
webDeployment.chatColumn: Persistent desktop collapse from chat header and floating reopen button; hidden panel inert; mobile Browser/Chat control retained

publicSourceRepository.hosting: Public GitHub repository; authenticated maintainer push

webDeployment.sidebar: Persistent compact desktop rail retaining logo, new chat, settings and profile; full mobile navigation retained

documentAttachments.reading: Local UTF-8, Poppler PDF text and sandboxed Tesseract eng/ita OCR, including mixed PDFs; bounded vision images for supported providers
documentAttachments.storage: Owner-bound encrypted original bytes and extracted text; selected-file private upload copies
documentAttachments.providerDisclosure: Only checked files enter the selected provider context; existing chat/provider retention is separate

taskProfiles.ownership: Per-user encrypted database procedures, versions and pending proposals; selected per chat
taskProfiles.learning: Agent proposes verified general steps/mappings; explicit human review creates a new revision
taskProfiles.starter: TIM contract-entry first-case guide; actual portal workflow requires supervised verification
taskProfiles.toolScope: Browser plus trusted internal document/memory MCP, excluding scripts, workspace and external MCP tools
taskProfiles.destinationPolicy: Configured exact HTTPS portal origins; selected-file uploads always require human approval and destination recheck
taskProfiles.caseSeparation: New profile revision or changed nonempty document selection starts fresh model context
